observationsNotFindings: The dispatch's central demand is a repair of two specific v1 sentences, and both repairs are real rather than nominal. I read frozen v1 to fix its text: its leftoverNameNote ended 'No leftover-join artifact for this gate exists.' and its doesNot carried 'Does not change required-now 26.' v2 replaces the first with 'g30 leftover-join.v3 (D-205) is the current G30 leftover-join.' and the second with 'Does not change live required-now 28.' Neither stale sentence survives anywhere in v2, and the only record of them is basedOn.predecessorV1.role, correctly past-tense and attributed to v1.

The lineage-confusion traps are handled structurally, not by disclaimer alone. Three separate basedOn nodes (namingV6, leftoverJoinV3, predecessorV1) each end with 'Not this artifact's version number', and two of them add that the two lineages' version numbers are unrelated. That is the right defence against a v3-leftover-join / v6-naming / v2-occupancy collision, and it is why parentReview could not drift onto either.

basedOn.d229.role is the narrowest node in the file: two custody sentences plus two disclaimers, with no leftoverDesign token, no OBL-* token and no leftover-join citation. The lineage sentences the dispatch wanted kept out of it sit in basedOn.leftoverJoinV3 and basedOn.d205 instead. The separation is deliberate and clean.

Three of the seven live members - not DR-101 core inventory, not G13 quality green, not G24 pack-identity admission - remain not-that-gate distinctions rather than measurable evidence, carried forward from v1 with ee null, notThatGate true and suppliedBy 'not a corpus class'. The file continues to say so plainly instead of padding them, which is why three corpus classes map to four members rather than seven. Recorded as continuity, not as a finding.

The two Codex absences in the cited chain (G30 harness v1 and g30-input-corpus.v1 have no codex review on disk) are disclosed in the verdict strings themselves rather than smoothed over. I confirmed both files are genuinely absent. Recorded because a reader of the chain should know the corroboration there is single-reviewer.

At 59236 bytes v2 is roughly 40 percent larger than v1's 41733, and the growth is almost entirely the remasurement lineage: the leftover-join.v3 and input-corpus nodes, the d205 and d229 recordings, the G24 and G29 sibling occupancy pins, and failsIf growing from 36 to 55 entries. The gate substance - seven members, three corpus classes, the EE partition - is carried forward unchanged, which is what a remasurement rather than a rewrite should look like.
